package callbacktwice

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct {
	read func(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error)
}

func NewChecked() Handlers   { return Handlers{read: checkedFigures} }
func NewUnchecked() Handlers { return Handlers{read: uncheckedFigures} }

func checkedFigures(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []int{1}, nil
}

func uncheckedFigures(ctx context.Context) ([]int, error) { return []int{1}, nil }

func serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, figures func(context.Context) ([]int, error)) {
	out, err := figures(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}

func (h Handlers) GetChecked(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)      { serve(w, r, checkedFigures) }
func (h Handlers) GetUnchecked(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)    { serve(w, r, uncheckedFigures) }
func (h Handlers) GetThroughField(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { serve(w, r, h.read) }
